arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Craig Goldblatt argued the stay does not require immediate return.
He stated creditors in lawful possession need not return property.
He argued they need not pay damages for holding it.

Ms. Sinzdak argued Section 362(a)(3) precludes acts to gain control. She said creditors may not repossess vehicles themselves. She said they may not direct tow companies to take vehicles. Mr. Wedoff asked if a creditor may stop a debtor from recovering property. He noted the debtor lacks a court order directing return. He argued the differences between statutes are insignificant.
